episodes.164725: Heavy rain fell across parts of northwest Oregon along with minor river flooding. The heaviest rain fell along and just north of a front that held nearly stationary from Newport to Albany to Mount Jefferson.
episodes.165301: A west storm force wind gust was measured at Passage Island Light on the early morning of the 20th.

events.narrative: The C-MAN station at Passage Island Light measured a west wind gust of 55 mph on the early morning of the 20th.
Measured rainfall of 2 to 4 inches. Minor flooding along the Marys River. No Damages reported.
Measured rainfall of 2 to 5 inches along the Oregon Coast Range. Minor flooding along the Siuslaw River near Mapleton. No damages reported.
Landslides dumped mud, trees, and rocks across Highway 126 about 10 miles east of Florence. An estimated 300 yards of the highway was covered by the landslide, which took about 24 hours to clear.
